scope: Five transparent 128x96 independent CairoSVG PNGs; canonical SVG source authored in this script, no Go-exported oracle.
Transformed compound nonzero clip with a hole, affine/reflected transforms tested analytically in Go as well.
Nested graphics clips, constant semitransparent embedded PNG under affine use, CSS plus clipPath/use and clipped use host.
Bitmap image edges lie outside the clip: isolates clip/image alpha from differing source-edge extension filters.

CairoSVG 2.7.1 ignores opacity on leaf use/image and mutates clipPath use x/y after first draw. Bitmap alpha is set on its parent g; repeated clipPath use uses an equivalent translate, and a separate single-use fixture tests x/y. Analytical Go tests cover native instance independence and opacity directly.
CairoSVG nested clipPath-on-clipPath semantics are not used as an oracle; native intersections are checked analytically instead.
No SVG-wide, Pango, Manim animation or full browser compatibility claim.
comparison: All pixels, premultiplied RGBA channel units 0..255. MAE <= .35, max <= 45, fraction with any channel delta>8 <= .02. Bounds/holes/source placement additionally checked analytically.
runtime: Pure Go. Python/CairoSVG/Cairo/Pillow only regenerate fixed development references; Go tests read files.

api.output: Existing immutable gomath.Clip on imported Objects; additional groups express intersections; fresh IDs and independent instance transforms

supported: One basic/path graphical child, or use directly referencing one basic/path shape; href and xlink:href
Compound nonzero path holes and implicit closure of open contours
Affine clipPath/graphic/use/target transforms, including reflection/shear/nonuniform scale; absolute/user-unit geometry
Definition light-tree CSS matching/inheritance; internal use shadow boundary; clip-path non-inherited except explicit inherit; initial/unset/none
Silhouettes ignore fill/stroke/opacity; child display/visibility affect clipping, with target visibility override
Clips on vectors/groups/text/tspan/bitmap/use/symbol; parent-child and clip-on-clip intersection; world normalization, ApplyMatrix and camera
Every clipPath compiled including unused; unknown/wrong-type references checked including overridden/unmatched CSS; errors abort Read without partial objects
unsupported: More than one graphical child (union), including hidden/disjoint cases
g/text/image/symbol silhouettes or internal use chains/non-basic targets
Clone-local clipPath definitions referenced from within a use clone; shared definitions outside cloned subtree supported
Percentage clip geometry/internal use positions, CSS basic-shape/geometry-box/fallback/escapes, URI percent encoding/external resources
xml:base in documents containing clipPath, unsupported attributes/namespaces
No new root/symbol overflow viewport clipping, image slice, mask/filter, group opacity isolation or browser/Manim-wide parity

limits_per_read.existing: 32MiB XML input; 128 XML/use depth; 100000 expanded objects including extra intersection groups; existing CSS/text/image budgets
limits_per_read.counting: Materialization budgets include source outlines, plan transforms and output instances. Final normalization is a fixed extra step. Stage limits, not a process peak-heap guarantee; rasterizer has separate limits.
